ABSOLUTE CAD PLAN CAMERA: mast represented only by one small CIRCLE viewed end-on, roofs as flat rectangular polygons with texture. NO mast shaft extending down the deck; NO building wall, window, doorway, church, onion dome, cross, fantasy ornament. Deck flat and exposed, bow bottom. This is a technical overhead plan rendered as a realistic painted sprite.
